robot: two I2RT YAM 6-joint arms with parallel two-finger grippers on a workstation table (YAMLab's bimanual setup)

frame.suite: the workstation's world frame: x forward from the arm bases towards the far side of the table, y to the left, z up
frame.base_text: the robot base frame: midway between the two arm bases at their mounting height, +X forward towards the far side of the table, +Y towards the left arm, +Z up; the left arm's base is at (0, +0.305, 0) and the right arm's at (0, -0.305, 0)

left.note: 6 joints (joint1..6, rad); end-effector pose = the tool frame left_tcp, the midpoint of the two fingertips (0.1426 m from link_6 along its approach axis)

ee.point: the midpoint of the two fingertips (tool frame left_tcp)
ee.mode_text: the service drives the tool frame to the pose by differential IK in closed loop along a straight line, at most 0.25 m/s (duration_s does not apply); an arm that ends more than 6 mm off is reported

right.note: 6 joints (joint1..6, rad); end-effector pose = the tool frame right_tcp, the midpoint of the two fingertips (0.1426 m from link_6 along its approach axis)

ee.point: the midpoint of the two fingertips (tool frame right_tcp)
ee.mode_text: the service drives the tool frame to the pose by differential IK in closed loop along a straight line, at most 0.25 m/s (duration_s does not apply); an arm that ends more than 6 mm off is reported

notes: At the start both arms are at their home pose (all joints 0, grippers open) with the tool frames pointing forward (+X). The gripper value in the state is the finger target in force; gripper_opening_m is the measured opening (0.095 m fully open; a gripper closed on an object stops above 0). Joint efforts (left_joint1_effort ...) in proprio_now grow when an arm pushes on something. A joint goal for one arm also re-sends the other arm's measured joints. The episode ends by itself at the first control step where the task's check holds.
